title: SANE: State Anomaly Neutralization for Stable Extreme-Context Delta-Rule Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.22354v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Delta-Rule recurrent models maintain a fixed-size state, enabling $O(1)$ inference memory but potentially becoming unstable under extreme-context extrapolation. By tracking RWKV-7 over sequences of up to 100M tokens, we empirically identify a distinct failure pattern: \textbf{localized norm explosion atop a relatively sparse substrate}, rather than global state saturation. Analysis of the recurrent update suggests that persistent decay keeps weakly updated entries small, whereas uneven injections allow a few channels to accumulate extreme values. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose \textbf{State Anomaly Neutralization (SANE)}, which applies adaptive $\tanh$ compression at chunk boundaries while preserving the intra-chunk parallel structure. translated_title: SANE：针对极端上下文Delta规则模型的状态异常中和
translated_abstract: 增量规则循环模型维持固定大小的状态，从而实现$O(1)$推理内存，但在极端上下文外推下可能变得不稳定。通过跟踪RWKV-7在长达1亿个令牌序列上的表现，我们实证识别出一种独特的失败模式：**在相对稀疏的基底上出现局部范数爆炸**，而非全局状态饱和。对循环更新的分析表明，持续衰减使弱更新条目保持较小，而不均匀的注入则允许少数通道累积极端值。基于这一诊断，我们提出**状态异常中和（SANE）**，该方法在块边界应用自适应$\tanh$压缩，同时保留块内并行结构。在安全阈值范围内（$3 \le \alpha \le 5$），SANE在11个短上下文推理基准上与基线匹配，无统计显著退化。在1亿个令牌前缀后，其性能保持稳定。
tldr: 本文提出SANE方法，通过自适应tanh压缩中和循环模型在极端上下文下的局部范数爆炸，在保持短上下文性能的同时实现长序列稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SANE, which neutralizes localized norm explosions in recurrent models under extreme contexts via adaptive tanh compression, maintaining short-context performance while ensuring long-sequence stability.
